lead.title: Minisforum's N5 and MS-S1 run local models on AMD's Ryzen AI Max+ PRO 495
lead.summary: Both new boxes use the 495 with an integrated Radeon 8060S GPU and reach up to 131 TOPS for on-device inference. They extend the mini-PC and appliance class of local-AI hardware beyond the DGX Spark-style category already on the market.

top_stories.title: RTX 5090 stock evaporates at US retailers, third-party listings reach $9,500
top_stories.summary: First-party inventory of the 32GB GDDR7 flagship is nearly gone, leaving marketplace listings between about $6,400 and $9,500 against a $1,999 MSRP. The squeeze is tied to the AI-driven memory shortage and reduced GeForce allocation, a direct input cost for any local rig.

top_stories.title: Mistral and Mozilla put Mistral models behind Firefox's Smart Window
top_stories.summary: The partnership makes Firefox's Smart Window beta assistant run on Mistral models, presented as an open, private and multilingual setup inside the browser.

top_stories.title: Arcee AI raises at least $150M Series B at a $1B pre-money valuation for open-weight models
top_stories.summary: The round was led by Vista Equity Partners with Cambium Capital and Emergence Capital, plus Microsoft's M12, AI10 Ventures, Hitachi, IAG, P7 and Wipro.

top_stories.title: Anew Labs spins ByteDance's drug-discovery unit out with $290M at a $1.5B valuation
top_stories.summary: The first external financing was co-led by HSG, IDG Capital and Hillhouse with 5Y Capital as co-lead; ByteDance keeps 56 percent of the standalone biotech.

items.title: Higher-order pruning of experts in mixture-of-experts language models
items.summary: Prunes MoE experts with joint rather than per-expert decisions to attack the parameter-count memory bottleneck, directly relevant to shrinking MoE checkpoints for local inference.

items.title: VLA-ULAP interleaves cloud VLA calls with an ultra-light local action predictor
items.summary: A roughly 7.4M-parameter on-device model absorbs most per-step decisions while intermittent cloud vision-language-action calls fill the gaps, cutting onboard power and hiding remote latency.

items.title: Beyond truncation: LLM decoding reframed as ensemble pruning
items.summary: Mahalanobis-Ensemble Decoding treats candidate-token selection as ensemble pruning and uses geometric semantic relations instead of scalar probabilities alone, a decoding-side quality and efficiency change.

items.title: A zeroth-order paradigm for LLM preference alignment
items.summary: Uses likelihood-margin information to address likelihood displacement in preference pairs, positioning a low-overhead alignment route for small-model post-training.

items.title: Infinite-parameter LLMs generate and adapt weights from live data
items.summary: Builds on MoE scaling where only a fraction of a stored parameter bank activates per token, and adapts weights from live data for memory-bounded serving of large sparse checkpoints.

items.title: YuE2-3B ships compact music generation with symbolic planning and zero-shot covers
items.summary: A 3.6B text-to-audio model covering music generation, zero-shot cover creation and agentic editing; the matching GitHub repo trended alongside, so weights and code arrived together.

items.title: GGUF quant ecosystem refresh: ISTA-DASLab and DavidAU repack Qwen3.8-27B
items.summary: Two community conversions of the 27B vision-language model are the highest-traffic quant pages, one carrying a GSQ/RCO recipe tag and the other a stacked Heretic/Uncensored/NEO-CODER/MAX/MTP lineage, i.e. merged and requantized variants rather than new architectures.

items.title: Quant-only releases keep the pipeline moving: Ornith-1.5-35B-A3B, Nex-N2.5-mini, LFM2.5-VL-3B
items.summary: Three trending GGUF artifacts cover a 35B A3B MoE, a 35B mini MoE and a 3B vision-language Liquid model, the drop-in weights for llama.cpp and GGML users who want the same numerics as the safetensors.

items.title: llama.cpp b11009-b11011: SYCL signature fix, Vulkan NVIDIA workaround, fused QKV split
items.summary: Three daily builds land in the window: a SYCL split-buffer signature fix (#28981) with prebuilt macOS Apple Silicon binaries, an NVIDIA argsort_large.comp workaround for the Vulkan backend (#28975), and split-state handling that lets --fuse-qkv work with mismatched Q/K dimensions on Gemma4 and Qwen35 (#28965).

items.title: Echodot: local-first AI that writes replies in your tone
items.summary: A local-first tool that rewrites replies in the user's own voice, running against local models rather than a hosted endpoint.

items.title: FastRecall: cheap shared memory across AI models
items.summary: An inexpensive memory layer that carries context between different AI models, aimed at multi-model local workflows.

items.title: Blue: open-source governance for coding agents
items.summary: A governance layer that organizes agent task state and approvals for repeatable local runs.

items.title: Cleanroom: an AI coding agent built to be read
items.summary: A coding agent that walks through its own steps at the user's pace, so the trace is legible as well as usable.

items.title: n8n 2.39.6 adds a v3 storage-directory rename rule and Gateway credit fixes
items.summary: The patch fixes the Gateway credits eligibility check against the correct sub-node, warns on the deprecated N8N_DB_PING_TIMEOUT variable, and self-hosters on 2.39.x should note the storage-directory rename ahead of the 3.0 migration.

items.title: Lemonade candidate-v2026.39.1 arrives for the local AI server
items.summary: The AMD-sponsored on-device server adds a configurable global prefill timeout and an experimental llamacpp-hrx backend on AMD GPUs.

items.title: ESPHome 2026.9.0 brings faster builds and encrypted updates to Home Assistant nodes
items.summary: Mostly incremental over the 2026.8.x patches, and relevant to local-Assist homelabs because ESPHome nodes are the on-device half of a Home Assistant plus local-LLM voice pipeline.

items.title: Lenovo extends Qira to 16GB PCs and shows RTX Spark Yoga laptops
items.summary: The Yoga models use Nvidia's GB10-class Grace-Blackwell superchip with up to 128GB of LPDDR5X unified memory, the attribute that lets larger quantized models fit in one compact box.

items.title: Hardware watch: the question is now where inference runs
items.summary: The defining issue for local hardware is no longer whether a device carries an NPU, but whether inference belongs on-device, at the edge or in the cloud, with hardware tiering driven by what autonomous agents require.

items.title: Micron puts a 37-year EDA veteran in charge of its $10B memory lab
items.summary: Hot Chips 2026 data shows accelerator compute compounding at 3x every two years against under 2x for HBM bandwidth, making the memory subsystem a first-order constraint and the bandwidth-per-watt gap what limits interactive decode.
